yaru-gtk-theme on Omarchy

The GTK widget theme behind Ubuntu's familiar desktop look.

Package data synced 2026-10-17 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install yaru-gtk-theme on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add yaru-gtk-theme. It is a 3.2 MB download (25.6 MB installed), version 26.10.3-3, licensed GPL3. Yaru default ubuntu gtk theme. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install yaru-gtk-theme on Omarchy

This is the core GTK2/GTK3 stylesheet of Yaru, Ubuntu's default theme, controlling how buttons, menus, title bars, and other widgets look and feel across GTK applications. It's built on top of upstream Adwaita and ships light and dark variants. This is the largest and most visible piece of the Yaru suite since it affects nearly every application window.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add yaru-gtk-theme
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 26.10.3-3:
    pacman -Qi yaru-gtk-theme

Open and use yaru-gtk-theme

yaru-gtk-theme has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql yaru-gtk-theme | grep /usr/bin/

Frequently asked questions

How do I install yaru-gtk-theme on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add yaru-gtk-theme. The download is 3.2 MB and it takes 25.6 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is yaru-gtk-theme free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL3.

How do I uninstall yaru-gtk-theme?

Run omarchy pkg drop yaru-gtk-theme. It removes the package from your system.

What does yaru-gtk-theme depend on?

The package declares 4 dependencies: gtk3, gdk-pixbuf2, gtk-engine-murrine, gnome-themes-extra. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is yaru-gtk-theme a desktop app?

No. yaru-gtk-theme has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is yaru-gtk-theme in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as yaru-gtk-theme (version 26.10.3-3) in the official Omarchy package repository. Ubuntu makes it. Project site: https://github.com/ubuntu/yaru. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
